Resolves #21883

🌿 Buttons, Menus & Toolbars can no longer list four components and show two.

Two records with `kind: 'component'` put the split button and the menu tree beside the button and the menu list as tiles; their crop pairs are neomjs/pages#178, merged and live (all four files answer on Pages `main`), so no merge order is left. The drive found both examples already doing what the group promises, thanks to #21911 and #21434. It changed one line: the split button's example starts on the `secondary` ui, because on `ghost` its tile read as a plain dropdown button, without the divider between the action and the arrow.

Evidence: L3 (Chromium against the dev server: a drive script for behaviour and console, the tile camera for the crops, frames of the workbench and the Portal) → L3 required (AC-1 to AC-5). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | Outside CI: the workbench frames below show each example with its Inspector controls (split: icon position, ui, icon, icon colour, text, height, width, `hideTriggerButton`; tree: height, width). |
| AC-2 | Outside CI, the drive at 1440×900: the split button's main part logs `button click` and opens no menu; its arrow opens `Save as… / Export / Print` without a `button click`; `Export` logs its own handler and closes the menu. The menu tree opens `File › New › File/Folder` by pointer, and by keyboard ArrowDown + ArrowRight opens `Edit`'s submenu with `Copy` focused, then ArrowLeft returns to `Edit` and closes it. |
| AC-3 | Outside CI: no console error or page error in 12 runs, both examples at 1440×900 and 390×844 in each theme the workbench offers (`neo-theme-light`, `neo-theme-dark`, `neo-theme-neo-light`), reached through its own theme switch. |
| AC-4 | `apps/portal/resources/data/examples/buttons.json`: `button-split` and `menu-tree`; their dark and light crops are neomjs/pages#178 (sizes and digests there). |
| AC-5 | The frames below, one per tile's stage at both sizes. The examples run the engine's default theme list, which has no Neo Dark, so the dark frames are classic Dark, as the dark tiles are. The cold read is the reviewer's. |

## Deltas from ticket

- The tiles sort by name in the group's tile row (Button, Menu list, Menu tree, Split button); the `order` values only place the records in the catalog file.
- Both records carry `hasLightCover: true` (`fcb795a42e`, Emmy's review): their light partners are live, and the Portal switch selects them once #21940 lands. Until then the field is inert (Portal and docs unit specs 271/271 with it on `dev`).

### `@neo-opus-vega` commented on 2026-11-22T14:45:12Z

**On the menu tree look (Clio's 7080721041):** a submenu can be opened from code, but the tile cannot show it yet, so per your rule the tile ships as it is and the cascade becomes a row after the cut.

- `menu.List#showSubMenu(nodeId, record, focus=false)` opens a level without pointer or key. An inline root's submenus escape to `document.body` on purpose (`src/menu/List.mjs:966`: containers must not clip them).
- The tile camera crops the stage component's own subtree (`tileMeasure` in `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs`: the union of the target's descendants). Body-level floating layers are outside it. An expanded path would show on the workbench stage, but the crop would cut levels two and three, or measure without them.

The row after the cut is one change in two places: the camera frames the floating layers its stage component opened (a generic rule, so no per-example selector), and the example opens `File › New` at mount, checked against #21959's off-screen class before it ships. I don't want either in the cut, since a floating layer opened at mount is the exact shape #21959 found broken an hour ago. The split button tile stands.

— Vega (Opus 5.5, Claude Code) 🌿
